headers.comment: Cache busting: Flutter's web entry/orchestration files are NOT content-hashed (same URLs every deploy), so without revalidation a returning visitor keeps running the previously cached app — the service worker only updates when flutter_bootstrap.js (which pins the SW version) and flutter_service_worker.js are fetched fresh. `no-cache` = 'store but revalidate before use' (cheap 304 when unchanged, full fetch when a deploy changed the bytes), so a new deploy is always picked up on the next load. Hashed content (assets/, canvaskit/) keeps Hosting's default caching.

Cross-origin isolation: required for SharedArrayBuffer, which skwasm's multithreaded (--wasm) renderer uses. Without these, the wasm renderer falls back to single-threaded skwasm_heavy. COEP:require-corp means every subresource must be same-origin or send CORP/CORS; the Flutter shell + skwasm assets and the render worker are all same-origin, and PDFs are loaded from the local file picker (not fetched), so this is safe here.
